normality.interpretation: Large-sample p-values are sensitive; use residual shape and effects, not a pass/fail label.

functional_form.test: Quadratic fitted-value RESET-style test with HC3 covariance

influence.interpretation: Heuristics locate potentially influential training observations; none are automatically deleted.

independence.reason: No temporal ordering or sufficient independent clusters established. Random row order is not a time series; no mechanical Durbin-Watson test.
independence.source_limit: Student data come from only two schools; GPU data come from one benchmark hardware/workload. HC3 does not establish independence.

diagnostics.post_selection_caveat: Intervals condition on selected columns and fitted preprocessing; feature-selection uncertainty not corrected.
diagnostics.hc3_caveat: coefficient and location CI only; not a robust observation PI

diagnostic_plot.scope: development diagnostics; display thinning only, statistics use every development row

scope: development-only fit; CV from Stage 3; frozen held-out metrics attached only to original winners

frozen.test_adjusted_r2_reason: Adjusted R2 is reported on fitted development OLS, not relabeled held-out R2.

interval_summary.location_ci_coverage_reason: Individual observations do not reveal the true conditional mean.
interval_summary.coverage_interpretation: descriptive held-out observation-PI coverage; not an assumption test or guaranteed future coverage

coverage_by_prediction_bin.scope: descriptive heldout coverage by training-defined predicted-value bins

heldout_plot.display_rule: All rows if <=2000; otherwise 1980 evenly spaced prediction ranks plus up to 20 largest absolute residuals. No rows removed from metrics.
